summary: ieisystem.inmanage added server_status to edit_m6_log_setting, updated edit_network_bond descriptions, and changed allowed auth_protocol/priv_protocol values in edit_snmp and edit_snmp_trap.
questions: What changed in ieisystem.inmanage SNMP modules?

answer_card.title: ieisystem.inmanage changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `edit_m6_log_setting`: new `server_status` attribute.
- `edit_network_bond`: attribute descriptions updated.
- `edit_snmp`, `edit_snmp_trap`: allowed value ranges for `auth_protocol` and `priv_protocol` changed.
